verdict.rationale: Whether a data warehouse's source is available under an open license is a fair question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows BigQuery's own source is published under an open license. The open-source MCP Toolbox is a separate companion tool, and support for open table formats like Iceberg is an adjacent feature; neither counts as the product's source being open.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
